title: Joint Pain (Vata)
ayurvedicView: Joint pain typically indicates Vata aggravation. Warmth, oil, and gentle movement help lubricate and strengthen joints.
remedies: Golden milk: turmeric + black pepper in warm milk
Warm castor oil compress on affected joints
Abhyanga (oil massage) with warm sesame oil
Stay warm and avoid cold, damp environments
A warm ginger compress over the stiff joint
tips: Stay warm, especially in cold weather
seeDoctor: A joint that is hot, red and swollen, or pain with fever
Pain after an injury, or being unable to bear weight
Pain that lasts more than a few weeks
